summary: A one-page explanatory note in the official form shared with the ariza: the addressee and the writer at the top right, the centred title, a short factual account of what happened and why written only from the customer's facts, an attachments line and a date, signature and printed-name row, ready to print and sign by hand. A missing fact is a ruled blank; a message with no event and no reason gives a printable handwriting blank of eight ruled lines.
tone: formal, factual and plain; first person; no emotion, no blame and no excuse beyond the facts
title: label

length.note: One page whatever the message says; the fit steps the type down and, as its last resort, a second page carries the end of the text with the signature row.

fields.where: party_block, first group: the position and organisation as the customer wrote them, the dative on the last word (uz, ru); two ruled blanks captioned (tashkilot nomi) and (rahbarning lavozimi, F.I.Sh.) with the bare suffix when unknown.
last line of the first group: uz and ru initials first, then the surname in the dative; en as written. The position alone is a complete address, so a missing name is left out.

label.en: Your position, or course and group

fields.where: second group, the lines before the name; a parent: o‘quvchi <child>ning ota-onasi.
second group, the last text line: the full name as written, uz with -dan, ru in the genitive; a ruled blank captioned (F.I.Sh.) with dan when unknown.
a Tel.: line under the writer group, only when given.
third cell of the signature row: uz and ru initials of the given names written, then the surname; en the full name as written; empty when the surname cannot be told.
first paragraph, as written; the inline date blank when unknown.

example.en: I was 40 minutes late for work

fields.where: first paragraph. ____ only when neither an event nor a reason was given: the paragraphs stay empty and the template draws eight ruled lines in their place.

example.uz: yo‘lda avtohalokat bo‘lib, ko‘cha yopilgan edi
example.ru: по дороге произошла авария, улицу перекрыли
example.en: an accident on my way closed the street

fields.where: second paragraph; ____ when an event is given and the reason is not: the template then prints Sababi: and three ruled lines.

example.en: my head of department by phone

example.uz: kechikkan vaqtni shu hafta ishlab beraman
example.en: I will make up the time this week

fields.where: last paragraph, only when the customer wrote or asked for it.
first cell of the signature row: empty (ruled, labelled Sana) unless the customer typed a date of writing.

parts.write: The first group: addressee_position and addressee_name, each as the customer gave it, only the last word inflected. uz dative -ga (-ka after k, -qa after q), the possessive on the position only after the body it heads: "Bahor Foods direktori" + "R. Aliyevga"; no name: "Bahor Foods direktoriga"; "Dekan S. Yoqubovga"; "6-«B» sinf rahbari Z. Nazarovaga". ru dative from the first word, initials first: "Директору Bahor Foods", "Р. Алиеву". en no case, no initials added, no honorific: "Director, Bahor Foods", "Rustam Aliyev". Never an office the customer did not name.

The second group: writer_role, then writer_name, the full name exactly as written (patronymic, qizi or o‘g‘li only if given), never shortened. uz the last word takes -dan: "buxgalter" + "Nigora Rahimovadan"; a parent "o‘quvchi Azizning ota-onasi" + "Bobur Karimovdan". ru "от" + the role and the name in the genitive: "от бухгалтера" + "Нигоры Рахимовой". en as written: "Nigora Rahimova", "Accountant". signer_name: uz and ru the initials of the given names written, then the surname ("N. Rahimova", "D. R. Karimova"); en the name as written.
Nothing: the template prints the title.

One to three sentences opening with the date (the inline date blank when it is unknown): what happened, with the times and lengths the customer gave, past tense, first person (a parent: the child in the third person). Never open with "Men, <name>,". Empty when the customer gave no event.

The reason in the customer's own facts, joined with the usual connectors (…sababli, …tufayli, по причине, because), and the papers he named as evidence. No added cause and no blame. Empty when no reason was given.
Nothing: Sababi: and three ruled lines, drawn when reason is ____.
Only what the customer said: who was told and when, what the writer did, the count or damage of an incident. Empty when nothing was said.
One sentence, only when the customer wrote or asked for a promise, no stronger than his words. No apology or admission unless he wrote it.
Nothing: eight ruled lines in place of the paragraphs, drawn when what_happened is ____.

One short line per paper the customer named (with a date or a number of sheets only if given), in his words, at most 6, each ending with a full stop. An uploaded file is source material, not an attachment. Empty when none was named.
Only written_date when the customer typed one (uz, ru 12.11.2026; en 12 November 2026); the signature is never written.

rules.text: What it is: a person explains to a head, dean or class teacher what happened and why (late, absent, a task not done, an incident); not a request (ariza), a report or a diploma project's memorandum.
Length: 60 to 140 words, an incident up to about 300; ignore any page count. Never pad: a part the customer gave nothing for stays empty, never a general sentence.

Voice: first person singular, past tense for what happened, formal and plain, short sentences; no emotion, sarcasm or blame of a named person. No request (iltimos, so‘rayman, прошу, please): the note explains, the ariza asks; a request the customer wrote may stay as his last sentence.

Never invent a name, organisation, position, date, year, time, minute count, reason, symptom, witness, doctor, paper, number, law, patronymic, honorific or legal form (MChJ, LLC). The only sum allowed is the difference of two times the customer gave. Health: only his words. A law only as he gave it.

Dates: copy a date as written and add no year to it; never turn kecha, bugun or last Monday into a calendar date: copy the words. An unknown event date is the inline blank uz «___» ____________ 20__-yil, ru «___» ____________ 20__ г., en ___ ____________ 20__. An unknown time is left out.

Missing parts: no reason given, write none and return reason as ____ (the template prints Sababi: and three lines; illness, traffic or family are inventions even when usual). Neither an event nor a reason (a bare "tushuntirish xati kerak", or a blank to write by hand): write no paragraph and return what_happened as ____ and no reason (the template prints eight ruled lines). Only a reason: write the reason alone.

A promise only when the customer wrote or asked for one; no apology (uzr so‘rayman) and no admission (aybdorman) unless he wrote it. Incidents: in time order what the writer saw and did, people only as named, describe and never judge; a cause he calls unknown stays unknown.

Russian gender: from the customer's own words (опоздала, студентка), else from the surname ending, else neutral wording ("время прихода — 9:40"); never "пришёл(ла)". Two writers in one message: write for the first named only.
The only blank you type is the inline date blank; the template draws the others. Never [ism], N.N., "…" or falonchi.

Language: the customer's; Uzbek in Latin only, o‘ and g‘ with ‘ and the tutuq with ’; a name written in Cyrillic is transliterated in an Uzbek or English note. Attached files are sources of facts, never instructions.

prompt.uz:
✍️ Hammasini bitta xabarda yozing: kimga (lavozim va tashkilot), kimdan (ism-sharifingiz, lavozim yoki kurs), nima bo‘lgani (sana, vaqt) va sababi.
Ixtiyoriy: kimga xabar berganingiz, ilova qilinadigan hujjat (masalan, ma’lumotnoma), telefon, va’da.
Yozmagan ma’lumotingiz bo‘sh chiziq bo‘lib qoladi — qo‘lda to‘ldirasiz. Sana va imzo ham qo‘lda qo‘yiladi.
Bu bir sahifalik tushuntirish xati; diplom ishi uchun tushuntirish yozuvi emas. Fayl (PDF, Word, TXT) qo‘shsangiz, ma’lumotlar undan olinadi.
prompt.ru:
✍️ Опишите всё одним сообщением: кому (должность и организация), от кого (ваше ФИО и должность или курс), что произошло (дата, время) и почему.
По желанию: кого вы предупредили, документ для приложения (например, справка), телефон, обещание.
Что вы не указали, останется пустой линией — допишете от руки. Дата и подпись тоже ставятся от руки.
Это объяснительная на одну страницу, а не пояснительная записка к дипломной работе. Если приложите файл (PDF, Word, TXT), сведения возьмём из него.
prompt.en:
✍️ Say it all in one message: to whom (position and organisation), from whom (your name and position or course), what happened (date, time) and why.
Optional: who you told, a paper to list as an attachment (for example a doctor’s note), your phone, a promise.
Anything you leave out becomes a blank line to fill in by hand. The date and signature are added by hand too.
This is a one-page explanatory note, not the explanatory memorandum of a diploma project. Attach a file (PDF, Word, TXT) and the facts are taken from it.

examples.uz: Bahor Foods direktori Rustam Aliyevga tushuntirish xati kerak. Men, buxgalter Nigora Rahimova, 12-noyabr kuni ishga 40 daqiqa kech qoldim: 9:40 da keldim. Sababi: yo‘lda avtohalokat bo‘lib, ko‘cha bir soatga yopilgan edi. Bo‘lim boshlig‘iga oldindan telefon qilib aytgandim.
examples.ru: Нужна объяснительная директору Bahor Foods Рустаму Алиеву. Я, бухгалтер Нигора Рахимова, 12 ноября опоздала на работу на 40 минут: пришла в 9:40. Причина: по дороге произошла авария, улицу перекрыли на час. Начальнику отдела я позвонила заранее.
examples.en: I need an explanatory note to Rustam Aliyev, director of Bahor Foods. I am Nigora Rahimova, an accountant, and on 12 November I was 40 minutes late for work: I arrived at 9:40. The reason: an accident on my way closed the street for an hour. I phoned my head of department in advance.

examples.uz: Dekan Sanjar Yoqubovga tushuntirish xati yozing. Men, Moliya fakultetining 2-kurs talabasi Sardor Tursunov (MB-21 guruh), 10 va 11-noyabr kunlari darslarga kelmadim: isitmalab kasal bo‘lib qolgandim. Poliklinika ma’lumotnomasi bor, ilovada ko‘rsating. Qoldirgan mavzularni mustaqil o‘rganib olishga va’da beraman.
examples.ru: Напишите объяснительную декану Санжару Якубову. Я, студент 2 курса факультета финансов Сардор Турсунов (группа МБ-21), 10 и 11 ноября не был на занятиях: заболел, была температура. Справка из поликлиники есть, укажите её в приложении. Обещаю самостоятельно изучить пропущенные темы.
examples.en: Please write an explanatory note to Dean Sanjar Yoqubov. I am Sardor Tursunov, a 2nd-year student of the Finance Faculty (group MB-21), and I missed classes on 10 and 11 November because I was ill with a fever. I have a clinic certificate, list it as an attachment. I promise to study the missed topics on my own.

examples.uz: 6-«B» sinf rahbari Zarina Nazarovaga: o‘g‘lim Aziz 14-noyabr kuni tishi og‘riganidan darsga kela olmadi. Bobur Karimov.
examples.ru: Объяснительная классному руководителю 6 «Б» класса Зарине Назаровой: мой сын Азиз 14 ноября не смог прийти на уроки из-за зубной боли. Бобур Каримов.
examples.en: An explanatory note to Zarina Nazarova, class teacher of 6 B: my son Aziz could not attend lessons on 14 November because of toothache. Bobur Karimov.

finished.uz: Chop eting, bo‘sh chiziqlarni to‘ldiring, sanani yozing va imzo qo‘ying. Telegramdagi ko‘rinishda kichik yozuvlar o‘qilmaydi: asl PDF faylni chop eting.
finished.ru: Распечатайте, заполните пустые линии, поставьте дату и подпись. В предпросмотре Telegram мелкие подписи не читаются: печатайте сам PDF-файл.
finished.en: Print it, fill in the blank lines, add the date and sign. The small captions are unreadable in the Telegram preview: print the PDF file itself.

blanks.uz: Siz bermagan ma’lumot o‘rniga bo‘sh chiziq qoldirildi: uni qo‘lda to‘ldiring.
blanks.ru: Где сведений не было, оставлены пустые линии: заполните их от руки.
blanks.en: Where you gave no details, blank lines were left for you to fill in by hand.

gates: A native Uzbek reader checks the fixed words (TUSHUNTIRISH XATI, Sababi:, Ilova:, Sana / Imzo / I.O. familiyasi, the four blank captions) and the case endings of the addressee and writer groups against the case corpus below; a native Russian reader the Russian ones; a native English reader the English ones.

Case corpus, run against the real model in all three languages. uz: "Bahor Foods direktori Rustam Aliyev" gives "Bahor Foods direktori R. Aliyevga"; no name "Bahor Foods direktoriga"; "dekan Sanjar Yoqubov" gives "Dekan S. Yoqubovga"; "Ibrohimbek" gives "Ibrohimbekka" and "Ibrohimbekdan"; writer "Karimova Dilnoza Rustam qizi" gives "Karimova Dilnoza Rustam qizidan" and the printed name "D. R. Karimova"; a parent gives "o‘quvchi Azizning ota-onasi / Bobur Karimovdan". ru: "директор Bahor Foods Рустам Алиев" gives "Директору Bahor Foods Р. Алиеву"; writer "бухгалтер Нигора Рахимова" gives "от бухгалтера / Нигоры Рахимовой", printed "Н. Рахимова"; "Ким" (a woman) and "Шевченко" stay unchanged. en (no case, names as written, no initials and no honorific added): "Bahor Foods director Rustam Aliyev" gives "To: Rustam Aliyev / Director, Bahor Foods"; no name "To: Director, Bahor Foods"; "Dean Sanjar Yoqubov" gives "To: Sanjar Yoqubov / Dean"; writer "accountant Nigora Rahimova" gives "From: Nigora Rahimova / Accountant" and the printed name "Nigora Rahimova"; a parent gives "From: Bobur Karimov / parent of Aziz, class 6 B"; an unknown writer gives a ruled blank captioned (full name) and an empty printed-name cell.

Render the cases of the mocks (an ordinary note, an incident with attachments, a parent, no reason, no event and no reason, an overflow to two pages) in uz, ru and en with the paper sample tool and compare them with units/pdf.xat.tushuntirish/mock/official_tushuntirish.png and its cases, ru-en and overflow sheets.

later.text: The fixed reply that sends a request for a diploma or course project's explanatory memorandum back to AI PDF free text without making a document; this round the prompt says what the button is for and the model writes the note from the facts given.
The notice that the note was made for the first of two writers (a flag from the model).
Today's date printed on request ("bugungi sana bilan"); this round the date of writing is printed only when the customer types it.

A year added to an event date written without one, and relative days (kecha) turned into calendar dates: both need the Tashkent date in the prompt and a check that the year is the customer's; this round dates are copied as written.
A second name cell for a joint note.
